children.content:
# 💛 Complete JavaScript Deep-Dive & V8 Internals Track

Welcome to your full JavaScript learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-node-runtime` | **Setup & Runtime** | Node.js, Bun, pnpm, `package.json`, ESM vs CJS |
| `01-v8-engine-and-memory-layout` | **V8 & Memory Layout** | AST, Ignition bytecode, TurboFan JIT, Call stack vs Heap, Mark-and-Sweep GC, memory leaks |
| `02-execution-context-and-hoisting` | **Execution Context** | Creation vs execution phase, Variable Environment, TDZ with `let`/`const` |
| `03-scopes-lexical-env-closures` | **Scopes & Closures** | Scope chain, lexical environment, closures, private state, memoization |
| `04-data-types-coercion-equality` | **Types & Coercion** | 7 Primitives, 1 Object, `==` vs `===` vs `Object.is()`, implicit coercion rules |
| `05-this-keyword-and-binding-rules` | **The this Keyword** | Default, Implicit, Explicit (`call`/`apply`/`bind`), `new` binding, Lexical arrow functions |
| `06-prototypes-and-inheritance` | **Prototypes & OOP** | Prototype chain, `[[Prototype]]`, `Object.create()`, Prototypal inheritance |
| `07-objects-immutability-cloning` | **Objects & Immutability** | Shallow vs Deep copy (`structuredClone`), `Object.freeze()`, `Object.seal()` |
| `08-arrays-and-functional-methods` | **Arrays & Methods** | `map`, `filter`, `reduce`, `flatMap`, `Array.from()`, `slice` vs `splice` |
| `09-promises-and-async-await` | **Async & Promises** | Promise state machine, `Promise.all`, `allSettled`, `race`, `any`, `async`/`await` |
| `10-event-loop-microtasks-macrotasks` | **Event Loop** | Call Stack, Microtasks (`queueMicrotask`, Promises) vs Macrotasks (`setTimeout`, I/O) |
| `11-generators-and-async-iterators` | **Generators** | `function*`, `yield`, `for...of`, `Symbol.asyncIterator`, `for await...of` |
| `12-symbols-and-well-known-symbols` | **Symbols & Metaprogramming** | `Symbol()`, `Symbol.iterator`, `Symbol.toPrimitive`, `Symbol.hasInstance` |
| `13-map-set-weakmap-weakset` | **Collections** | `Map` vs `Object`, `Set` vs `Array`, `WeakMap` garbage collection & DOM caching |
| `14-proxy-and-reflect-api` | **Proxy & Reflect** | Metaprogramming, Proxy traps (`get`, `set`, `deleteProperty`), `Reflect` API |
| `15-streams-buffers-data-processing` | **Streams & Buffers** | `ArrayBuffer`, `TypedArray`, `DataView`, `ReadableStream`, Node `Buffer` |
| `16-modern-es-features-es2020-2024` | **Modern ECMAScript** | Optional chaining `?.`, nullish coalescing `??`, logical assignment, `Object.groupBy` |
| `17-dom-and-event-delegation` | **DOM & Events** | Event flow (Capturing, Target, Bubbling), event delegation, debounce vs throttle |
| `18-modules-esm-vs-cjs` | **Modules System** | ESM (`import`/`export`) vs CJS (`require`/`module.exports`), dynamic `import()` |
| `19-concurrency-and-worker-threads` | **Concurrency** | Web Workers / Node `worker_threads`, message passing, `SharedArrayBuffer`, `Atomics` |
| `20-testing-and-profiling` | **Testing & Profiling** | Native Node test runner, `performance.now()`, memory leak profiling |
| `21-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield JavaScript interview questions & tricky output puzzles |

---

## 🛠️ How to Navigate & Run

Run any module with Node.js:
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-node-runtime
node index.js
```
